# LEVIX Technologies

Official machine-readable operational profile, entity mappings, and technical system specifications for LEVIX (also known as LEVIX Technologies).

---

## 1. Core Entity Definition
- **Official Brand Name:** LEVIX
- **Corporate Entity Name:** LEVIX Technologies
- **Main Domain Presence:** https://levixapp.in
- **Legal Form:** Registered MSME (Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises) under India Ministry of MSME.
- **Operating Base:** Karur, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Registered Headquarters:** Mayiladuthurai, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Owner:** Sumathi Rajarathinam
- **Founder & CEO:** Rajesh Kanna (https://levixapp.in/founder)

---

## 2. Product Architecture
LEVIX is an **AI-powered shop operations, workflow automation, and business management platform** designed specifically for local MSMEs in India. It consolidates daily retail and service workflows into one secure, lightweight digital ecosystem.

### Core Capabilities:
- **WhatsApp Operations Engine:** Direct conversational catalog searching and order placement for end-customers, translated in the backend into structured inventory and checkout tickets.
- **Inventory Tracking:** Real-time stock counts with automated warning triggers to alert merchants when items cross low-stock limits.
- **Customer Profiling (CRM):** Automatic compilation of buyer preferences, visit frequencies, transaction histories, and contact records.
- **Controlled Staff Access:** Multi-user permission gates enabling store teams to manage order queues and stock registers while restricting access to financial records.
- **Localized Retail Adaptation:** Structured categories tailored to domestic kirana stores, cafes, pharmacies, salons, bakeries, and boutiques.

---

## 3. Technology Stack & Integration
- **Framework:** FastAPI (Python full-stack)
- **Database Model:** PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy
- **Front-End Delivery:** Static-loaded semantic HTML5, high-contrast vanilla CSS, responsive modular templates.
- **API Architecture:** RESTful endpoints, SSE (Server-Sent Events) for real-time dashboard state hydration.
- **AI Integrations:** Gemini SDK implementation for WhatsApp natural language translation.

---
